description: Review an MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code JSON) for deprecated or known-stale servers with suggested replacements, an estimated tool count and token cost of tool definitions where Signal Lab has audit data, a warning if the stack is over Cursor's 40-tool cap, and flags for risky mixes such as an untrusted-content reader plus shell or write tools (the lethal trifecta). The config is parsed only: commands are not run, URLs from the config are not fetched, and the config is not stored. Environment values are discarded. At most 16384 bytes.

config.description: The MCP client config as a JSON string or object (mcpServers or servers).

name: check_stack
title: Check an MCP agent stack
